nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle First Spray Hydrating Glow Mist Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report a hydrating, glowy effect that doesn't dry out their skin further, though one with dry cheeks reacted to the fragrance with stinging and burning, and another cautions the hydration may not be deep enough for very dry skin.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it doesn't feel heavy or greasy and helped balance an oily shine into a more even glow.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it keeps an oily T-zone in check while still hydrating drier areas of the face.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no irritation from the spray.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe an immediate hydrating, dewy effect, though a few say the glow and moisture fade quickly or that it left their skin feeling dry and a little sticky.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention smoother-looking fine lines after use or hope to see wrinkles soften with continued use, though some say results aren't yet noticeable.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with naturally oily skin say it doesn't add greasiness and can balance an oily shine into a more even glow.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report a few breakouts after use, though most reviewers do not mention any breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Fine, even mist that layers under makeup
Bottle feels cheap for a luxury product

extraits.texte: I have dry cheeks and like a dewy look for makeup. I fell for the social media hype and ordered this. The very day that it came I tried it over my MAC Studio Fix powder, and it INSTANTLY made my face sting and burn. Awful. I waited a few minutes to see if it would die down, but it just got worse, so I had to go wash my face. It has a VERY strong fragrance, which may be why it burned. I am so disappointed, I love hydrating mists and wanted to love this one, but it is a fail.

extraits.titre: Didn't see much of a result
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I was really excited to hear I was receiving this product as I've seen some great reviews but it left me feeling a little disappointed. I immediately started using it as directions said to shake and spray, I did enjoy the light rosey scent however it didn't do much beyond that. It seemed like it absorbed instantly and I didn't see that "dewy" look and I also noticed with consistent use I got a few breakouts which was surprising because my skin never breakouts. So overall I don't believe I'd purchase this product myself

extraits.titre: Hydrating with a glow but doesn't last long
extraits.texte: I received this serum for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I'm 43 years old with normal to dry skin. I was excited to get this spray in hopes that it would help my face be more moisturized and glowing. The spray serum with a few good shakes easily combined so I know I got a good mix of both the spray and serum. I love how easily it dispensed a wide amount of product evenly on my skin, so I only had to give it a few sprays. Afterwards my skin soaked up the serum quickly and felt refreshing. The smell was ok and wasn't bad but definitely not my favorite. I had a nice little dewy glow for a bit but wished it lasted longer. I would have given it 5 stars if I felt like it helped eliminate my dryness after a few weeks of use but unfortunately it was only a temporary fix after each spray.

extraits.titre: This product is what I've been looking for!
extraits.texte: D`ALBA sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. My skin has been in search of hydration and gkow and this brought it. I used it with and without makeup and it looked and felt great on my skin. Gave a youthful glow and didnt get greasy or dry up as the day went on. I could not smell a scent or anything from it(wish it did have some pretty scent) and made sure to not breath it in. I have combination skin and my t zone get greasy but I get dry around my face and had no issues with this product. Its a must try.

extraits.titre: Glow-y and Good for Dry Skin
extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this spray serum because I've never tried a product like this before. So far, I am really enjoying it! I have very dry skin so I'm always a little nervous when I try new products for fear they could dry my skin out even more. Luckily, this one does not and leaves my skin glow-y and moisturized. Great if you like the dewey look. I haven't noticed it break me out, mess up my makeup, or really any negative effects. I enjoy the scent but you may want another product if you prefer something that has no scent at all. I haven't noticed it lessen my wrinkles quite yet but I'm hoping I will see that result after using this product a little longer.

This serum provides an instant refresh and lift to my skin. If you feel like your skin is dull, dry, or just less vibrant, give it a try! It will restore the bouncy radiance to your skin. The scent is light and pleasant, nothing remarkable, a bit floral. I didn't feel like it was too intense. The hydrating effect on my skin lasted quite a while. I would absolutely purchase this again and again. My skin in naturally oily, but has been lacking a glow - instead it has an oily shine. This helped everything feel balanced and radiant. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
